theme: 教材片語・中高階 750–850 第 21 群

items.colloc: update billing information 更新帳單資訊 | verify billing information 核對帳單資訊
items.distinct: payment method 付款方式 | shipping address 寄送地址
ex: Please update your billing information online.
請在線上更新您的帳單資訊。
The system requires valid billing information.
系統需要有效的帳單資訊。
Check your billing information before submitting.
送出前請檢查您的帳單資訊。

items.pos: phr. 費心去做；特意去做
items.colloc: bother to check 費心檢查 | bother to attend 撥冗參加
items.distinct: make an effort 努力 | take the trouble 費事
ex: He didn't bother to check the report.
他沒費心去檢查那份報告。
Did you bother to email the client?
你有特意發郵件給客戶嗎？
They didn't bother to attend the meeting.
他們沒費心去參加會議。

items.colloc: box office hit 票房熱賣 | box office records 票房紀錄
items.distinct: ticket counter 櫃檯 | window 窗口
ex: Tickets are available at the box office.
票可以在售票處購買。
The film was a huge box office success.
這部電影在票房上非常成功。
Please pick up tickets at the box office.
請到售票處領取票券。

items.colloc: cover breaking news 報導突發新聞 | hear breaking news 聽到突發新聞
items.distinct: headline 頭條新聞 | current events 時事
ex: We have some breaking news to report.
我們有一些突發新聞要報導。
The channel interrupted with breaking news.
該頻道中斷節目播放突發快訊。
Everyone was shocked by the breaking news.
大家都被那則突發新聞震驚了。

items.colloc: bring on changes 帶來改變 | bring on problems 引起問題
items.distinct: cause 導致 | result in 導致
ex: Stress can bring on serious health issues.
壓力會導致嚴重的健康問題。
What brought on such a sudden decision?
是什麼導致了這麼突然的決定？
Poor planning brought on the project delay.
計畫不周導致了專案延遲。

items.colloc: bring out a product 推出產品 | bring out the best 發揮最大優勢
items.distinct: publish 出版 | launch 發布
ex: The company will bring out a new model.
公司將會推出一款新機型。
This project brought out their best talent.
這個專案發揮了他們最佳才華。
They plan to bring out a monthly magazine.
他們計畫出版一本月刊。
The event will bring together global leaders.
該活動將召集全球領導人。
We need to bring together different teams.
我們需要將不同團隊整合在一起。
This partnership will bring together both firms.
這項合作將聯合兩家公司。
items.colloc: bring together experts 召集專家 | bring together resources 整合資源
items.distinct: assemble 集合 | gather 聚集

items.colloc: bring up a topic 提出議題 | bring up an issue 提起問題
items.distinct: mention 提到 | raise 提出
ex: Please bring up this matter at the meeting.
請在會議中提出這件事。
I wanted to bring up a new suggestion.
我想提一個新的建議。
No one dared to bring up the budget.
沒人敢提起預算的問題。

items.colloc: build up confidence 建立信心 | build up a reputation 建立聲譽
items.distinct: construct 建設 | develop 開發
ex: We need to build up our market share.
我們需要逐步建立市場份額。
He worked hard to build up his reputation.
他努力建立了良好的聲譽。
Let us build up a strong team culture.
讓我們逐步建立強大的團隊文化。

items.pos: n. 商業慣例；經營模式
items.colloc: ethical business practice 道德商業慣例 | standard business practice 標準商業慣例
items.distinct: business operation 商業運作 | commercial activity 商業活動
ex: They follow standard international business practices.
他們遵循國際標準商業慣例。
Ethical business practice is our core value.
道德經營模式是我們的核心價值。
The audit reviewed all current business practices.
審計審查了所有現行的商業慣例。

items.pos: phr. 扣上鈕扣；妥善完成
items.colloc: button up a project 妥善完成專案 | button up the details 處理細節
items.distinct: complete 完成 | finalize 定案
ex: Make sure you button up your shirt.
確認你的襯衫鈕扣扣好了。
We need to button up the contract details.
我們需要將合約細節妥善收尾。
Can you button up the task by Friday?
你能週五前妥善完成任務嗎？

items.pos: phr. 當然；務必；無論如何
items.colloc: by all means attend 務必參加 | by all means proceed 請務必進行
items.distinct: certainly 當然 | definitely 絕對
ex: If you need help, by all means ask.
如果你需要幫忙，儘管開口。
By all means, please proceed with the plan.
請務必按照計畫進行。
You should by all means join the seminar.
你務必參加那場研討會。

items.pos: phr. 相較之下；與之相比
items.colloc: stand by contrast 有鮮明對比 | marked by contrast 形成對比
items.distinct: in comparison 相比之下 | however 然而
ex: Sales rose; by contrast, costs remained low.
銷售額上升；相較之下，成本維持低檔。
The office is quiet; by contrast, the lab is busy.
辦公室很安靜；相比之下，實驗室很忙。
By contrast, our competitors are struggling now.
相較之下，我們的競爭對手現在正處於困境。

items.colloc: call on a client 拜訪客戶 | call on someone to do 要求某人做
items.distinct: visit 訪問 | request 要求
ex: The manager will call on key clients today.
經理今天會去拜訪重要客戶。
She called on the team to work harder.
她號召團隊更加努力工作。
The speaker called on the audience to vote.
演講者要求聽眾進行投票。

items.pos: phr. 大聲叫喊；指責；召喚
items.colloc: call out errors 指出錯誤 | call out for help 大聲求助
items.distinct: shout 大叫 | identify 指出
ex: He was quick to call out the error.
他很快就指出了那個錯誤。
They called out for more staff support.
他們大聲呼籲需要更多員工支援。
Don't be afraid to call out unfair behavior.
別害怕指責不公平的行為。

items.colloc: check carry on baggage 檢查手提行李 | store carry on baggage 收好手提行李
items.distinct: checked baggage 托運行李 | personal item 個人隨身物品
ex: Please stow your carry on baggage carefully.
請小心存放您的手提行李。
Is this bag allowed as carry on baggage?
這個包包可以當作手提行李嗎？
Only one piece of carry on baggage is allowed.
僅允許攜帶一件手提行李。

items.colloc: meet the chief financial officer 會見財務長 | report to the chief financial officer 向財務長匯報
items.distinct: CEO 執行長 | accountant 會計師
ex: The chief financial officer approved the budget.
財務長批准了預算。
Our chief financial officer has a strong background.
我們的財務長背景很強。
You should report to the chief financial officer.
你應該向財務長匯報。

items.colloc: screw come loose 螺絲鬆脫 | handle come loose 把手鬆開
items.distinct: detach 分離 | break 斷裂
ex: The handle on the door has come loose.
門上的把手鬆脫了。
A screw came loose during the machine test.
測試機器時螺絲鬆脫了。
Check if any cables have come loose.
檢查看看是否有電纜鬆脫。

items.colloc: come to a final decision 做出最終決定 | come to a decision quickly 快速做決定
items.distinct: make a decision 做決定 | reach a conclusion 達成結論
ex: It took time to come to a decision.
花了一些時間才做出決定。
We need to come to a decision by noon.
我們需要在中午前做出決定。
Management has come to a decision on hiring.
管理層已對聘用做出決定。

items.colloc: come to an agreement on price 就價格達成協議 | finally come to an agreement 最終達成共識
items.distinct: reach an agreement 達成協議 | sign a contract 簽署合約
ex: Both parties have come to an agreement.
雙方已經達成協議。
Can we come to an agreement today?
我們今天能達成協議嗎？
They failed to come to an agreement on terms.
他們未能就條款達成共識。
